name: How do condensation-control services compare to running a dehumidifier?
description: Dehumidifiers temporarily dry room air, while professional condensation control permanently fixes thermal bridging, insulation voids, and improper ventilation.

mainEntity.name: How do condensation-control services compare to running a dehumidifier?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standalone dehumidifier removes moisture from indoor air but does not fix the building defects causing warm air to contact cold surfaces. Condensation-control services address the root physical causes—poor envelope insulation, thermal bridging, and unsealed air penetrations. While portable dehumidifiers incur ongoing electricity costs and require constant emptying, professional structural fixes provide a permanent balance without relying on continuous temporary equipment.
